title: C-UAS Case of a Refinery in Brazil
title_en: C-UAS Case of a Refinery in Brazil
description:
2025 C-UAS Case of a Refinery in Brazil
Equipment Used:
Stationary Spectrum Identification Equipment
Airspace Awareness Platform
Command and Control Platform Software
Project Introduction:
In 2025, this refinery project deployed a C-UAS early-warning operation for key production and perimeter areas. Stationary spectrum identification equipment collects radio-frequency activity, while the awareness platform organizes airspace tracks, alert records, operator notes, positioning review, tracking status, and review status in one interface. The command platform supports authorized teams with event logging, cross-department notification, and documented response protocols. Public documentation focuses on early warning, identification, positioning, tracking, evidence records, and compliant response procedures.
